log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'stderr' to log to console.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

policy_file.description: Path to the OpenStack policy (RBAC) configuration file.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Designate agent service.

host.description: IP address for the agent's internal RPC endpoint to bind to.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

backend_driver.description: DNS backend driver to use. Common options: 'designate-mdns', 'bind9'.

managed_resource_tenant_id.description: Tenant ID to restrict zone management to (deprecated in recent releases; leave blank for multi-tenant).

backend_options.description: Backend-specific configuration options (key-value pairs). Example: for mdns, {'mdns_service_id': '...', ...}; for bind9, {'rndc_host': '127.0.0.1', ...}.

value.description: Configuration value (string or number as string)

notification_driver.description: Notification driver; use 'messagingv2' to send events to Oslo Messaging, 'noop' to disable.

notification_topic.description: Message bus topic to publish DNS change notifications to.
